recommended_scenario.title: Cortijo Conjuro: Native Vegetation and Water Learning Demonstrator
recommended_scenario.preferred_site: A suitable patch on the user-owned Cortijo Conjuro land, subject to a site survey and written use agreement; neighbouring land is a separately reviewed alternative
recommended_scenario.area_status: Retained planning footprint, not surveyed available area or verified ecological capacity
recommended_scenario.plant_count_basis: Six same-species matched pairs: one carob pair, two lentisk pairs, three retama pairs. Feasibility design, not power-derived ecological density.
recommended_scenario.comparison: Within each matched pair, randomly allocate one plant to added stone mulch and the other to no added stone. Retain pre-existing natural cover in both.
recommended_scenario.water_basis: Author-proposed first-year logistics ceiling for 12 plants, not a watering prescription or survival guarantee. Technical review and supply evidence required.
recommended_scenario.publication: At least three years after final payment; keep method and emerging results online from the start
recommended_scenario.attendance_status: Targets only; safe capacity, partners and participation unconfirmed
recommended_scenario.funding_conclusion: The case is not currently demonstrated to meet the 60-point threshold. Proposed delivery claims and applicant history/memberships remain unverified.
